kindHint.BASE: Prices every customer without a list of its own. One base list per company and currency.
kindHint.CUSTOMER: One customer's own prices; a style it lacks comes from the list it falls back to.
kindHint.GROUP: A discount group: every customer given this list is in the group.
kindHint.CONTRACT: Prices agreed in a contract, with their own dates.

live.offline: Offline — changes wait to be sent

noAccess.title: You don't have access to price lists
noAccess.body: Price lists need the right to see them (pricelists.view): the Sales, Finance and Owner roles have it.

list.intro: Customer price lists by dated version: a quote takes its line prices from the list of its customer, and keeps the version it was priced with.
list.exportNothing: Nothing to export in this view

empty.title: No price lists yet
empty.body: Make the base list first: it prices every customer without a list of its own.
empty.bodyView: A person with the right to keep price lists makes them.

bulk.archivedPartly: {done} archived, {failed} refused: they price customers or a list falls back to them.

held.noManage: Your role can see price lists, not change them
held.noPartiesManage: Giving a list to customers also needs the right to change customers
held.noPrice: Your role sees no selling prices: the prices are not shown
held.noStyles: Your role cannot see styles to pick from
held.archived: The list is archived: reactivate it first
held.noVersion: The list has no version yet
held.activeVersion: Version {revision} is in force: its prices stay as they are. Make the next version to change prices.
held.activeHasDraft: Version {revision} is in force: its prices stay as they are. Change the prices on the draft.
held.oneDraft: A draft waits already: one draft at a time
held.nothingToArchive: None of these can be archived: they price customers
held.archiveCustomers_one: {count} customer is priced from this list: give it another list first
held.archiveCustomers_other: {count} customers are priced from this list: give them another list first
held.archiveFallback: {lists} fall back to this list: change them first

new.title: New price list
new.body: The list is made with its version 1 as a draft: nothing is in force until a version is activated.
new.name: Name
new.companyHint: A list of every company can be used by each one.
new.baseHint: A style missing here is priced from this list.
new.validFromHint: Kept as a plan: the version goes live when it is activated.

problem.code: Up to 40 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores
problem.currency: A currency code such as EUR or CHF
problem.baseOfBase: A base list falls back to nothing
problem.toBefore: On or after the first day

refused.codeTaken: That code is in use: choose another one.
refused.codeOrBase: That code is in use, or this company already has a base list in this currency (archive it first, or make a customer, group or contract list).
refused.base: That list cannot be the one it falls back to: it must be active, of this company or every company, and in the same currency.
refused.company: That company cannot have this list: choose another one.
refused.fields: Some fields were refused: check the code, the name and the days.

archive.title: Archive {code}
archive.body: An archived list prices nobody and is out of the pickers; its versions and the quotes priced from it stay as they are. It can be reactivated.
archive.skipped_one: {count} selected list is left out: it prices customers or is archived.
archive.skipped_other: {count} selected lists are left out: they price customers or are archived.
archive.refused: Not archived: customers are priced from it, or a list falls back to it.
archive.refusedReactivate: Not reactivated: the list it falls back to is archived, or it is a second base list.

record.name: Price list
record.notFoundBody: It may have been removed, or it belongs to a company you cannot see.
record.changed: Someone else changed this list at {time}
record.archivedBanner: Archived: it prices nobody. Reactivate it to change it.

empty.title: No prices yet
empty.body: Add styles: one price per style, or per colourway when it differs.

prices.autosave: Each price is saved when you leave its cell (Enter or Tab). Esc puts back the saved one.
prices.grainNote: Standard cost and margin are not in your role: those columns are absent.
prices.grainNoteCost: Standard cost is not in your role: margin % only.
prices.emptyCell: A price for {style} was left empty: it stays as it was. Remove the row instead.
prices.invalid: The price of {style} is not a number above 0: it is not saved.
prices.refused: Not saved: the style or colourway is archived, or not of this list’s company.

held.pctInvalid: A percent above -100, not 0, with at most 4 decimals

remove.body: These rows leave the draft: a quote then finds no list price for them here.
remove.bodyFallback: These rows leave the draft: their styles are then priced from {base}.

add.title: Add a price to version {revision}
add.colourHint: Every colourway, or one whose price differs (it wins over the style's).
add.priceHint: Net per piece; a consumer quote adds VAT to it.

held.taken: This version prices it already: change it in the grid

customers.intro: Who gets this list as their default price list. One customer’s list is also changed on its record (Tax & terms).
customers.introGroup: The customers of this discount group: each gets this list as its default price list.

empty.title: Not assigned
empty.body: No customer has this list yet.
empty.base: A base list prices every customer without a list of its own: it needs nobody here.

customers.fallbackOf: Lists that fall back to this one: {lists}.
customers.addBody: Each customer picked gets this list as its default (in {currency}); new quotes take their prices from it.
customers.removeBody: They are then priced from the base list; their open quotes keep the version they were priced with.
customers.refused: Not changed: a customer of another company, archived, in another currency, or one your role may not change.

versions.intro: Each version has its days; open quotes keep the version they were priced with.
versions.name: Version {revision}
versions.quotesKeep: A version in force is kept for good: change prices on the next one, then activate it from a day.
versions.made: Version {revision} made as a draft with {count} prices copied.
versions.refused: Not made: a draft waits already, or the list is archived.

activate.title: Activate version {revision}
activate.body: From its first day this version prices new quotes; the version in force then ends the day before.
activate.fromHint: Today or later, never back in time.
activate.toHint: Leave empty to keep it open.
activate.endsNone: Nothing else is in force on those days
activate.quotesKeep: Quotes priced up to {before} keep the version they were priced with.

held.past: From today ({today}) or a later day: never back in time
held.order: The last day is on or after the first
held.later: Version {revision} is active from {date}: start this one later, or end that one first
held.other: These days cannot be activated: check them against the other versions
held.noPrices: The draft has no prices yet: add styles first

activate.doneEnded: Version {revision} is active from {from}; version {ended} ends on {to}.
activate.refused: Not activated: the days clash with another version, or the draft changed meanwhile.

compare.title: Compare two versions
compare.summary_one: {count} row changed from version {before} to version {after}.
compare.summary_other: {count} rows changed from version {before} to version {after}.

read.signed_out: Your session ended: sign in again.
read.not_found: It is not there any more.
read.unavailable: The server did not answer: try again in a moment.
read.rate_limited: Too many requests: wait a moment.
read.contract: The answer did not match this page: reload the page.
read.internal: Something went wrong on the server.

write.moved: Someone else changed it meanwhile: read again, nothing was overwritten.
write.refused: Refused as it is: check the values.
write.signed_out: Your session ended: sign in again.
write.forbidden: Your role may not do this.
write.not_found: It is not there any more.
write.step_up: Confirm it is you with your authenticator first.
write.rate_limited: Too many requests: wait a moment.
write.unavailable: The server did not answer: nothing was changed, try again.
write.internal: Something went wrong on the server: nothing was changed.
